name: planned-update-preserves-edges
body: `apg plan update <project> planned <fqn> [--name N] [--parent P]` must exist and be edge-preserving: it updates the planned node's name/parent and its parent `Contains` edge (set-semantics for parent) while leaving unrelated incident edges intact. Refuse if the planned FQN is not declared. Acceptance: updating a planned node's parent repoints the parent `Contains` edge without touching other plan edges.
